name: ask-credential-switching
description: Best effort, ask only. Asks a person before a shell command switches the identity later commands act as: aws --profile, AWS_PROFILE= or AWS keys (also $env:), sts assume-role, configure set of a key; gcloud account, configuration, login or impersonation; az account set, az login as a principal or identity; kubectl use-context or set-credentials; writes to ~/.aws, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.azure. Names in .chock/credential-allowlist.json pass. Misses: scripts, SDKs, env files, credential_process. [Session-enforced in Codex by a PreToolUse hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Codex Desktop, Windows, 2026-08-24; the deny is returned as hook JSON, not an exit code, which Codex's Windows shell wrapper mangles). Codex requires a one-time trust review per hook -- the plugin is ADVISORY until you approve its hook, and a plugin update voids that trust until re-approved. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py) on PATH; with no working Python it exits 2 rather than allowing, and any other failure of the HOOK (missing git, a timeout, an unexpected exit) fails OPEN. A failure of the GUARD it runs is a DENY here, because Codex rejects the confirmation prompt the other clients get. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`.]
